pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Bubba G, let me tell you something, you’ve somehow pitted both your teams, France and Morocco, against each other, and it shows exactly why you're barely clinging to first place — sheer luck and outrageous drafting chaos!** Look at me, Gunner, this is all you: you hogged the draft for a fantasy scenario where you cannibalize your own teams! France may be cruising in, seasoned with the flair of Mbappé, but your strategic ineptitude is laid bare with Morocco on the chopping block. The French are worldly, measured in dominance; they’re not doing you a favor, they're doing the tournament a favor — they're going to systematically dismantle the very Moroccan spirit you touted as your secret sauce. I predict with the hyperbolic certainty you all should adopt: France reigns supreme, and Gunner's leads mean nothing when your own roster visits self-destruction.
